        '## Full intake record
http://100.83.59.73:8767/ui/#/intake-gate/' + $('Validate + normalize').first().json.intakeId + '.json'

={{ JSON.stringify({
  from: 'founder@efficientlabs.ai',
  to: [$('Validate + normalize').first().json.summary.client_email],
  subject: 'Your AI Sovereignty Audit submission — Efficient Labs',

        '  ' + $('Validate + normalize').first().json.intakeId + '

        'If anything is urgent, reply to this email.

        '— Michael Ward
Founder, Efficient Labs
  https://efficientlabs.ai'

parameters.jsCode: const r = $('Validate + normalize').first().json; return [{ json: { success: true, intake_id: r.intakeId, message: 'Intake received. Operator notified.' } }];
const r = $input.first().json; return [{ json: { success: false, errors: r.errors, message: 'Validation failed; no intake stored.' } }];

_archetype_metadata.description: Internal audit-intake workflow for the Efficient Labs Tally form. NOT a client deliverable — this is the production intake pipeline for our own audit product. Lives in efficient-labs n8n at https://n8n.efficientlabs.ai.
